I completely understand your concern about quality, especially when investing in pieces for your home and family. It's so important to choose products that are built to last and meet high standards.

At Namesake, quality is at the heart of everything we do. Our nursery pieces are carefully crafted and undergo extensive quality testing to ensure they become cherished heirlooms in your family for years to come. We're proud to continue a legacy of over 30 years of experience in nursery furniture design and manufacturing.

Here are some key aspects that highlight our commitment to quality and safety:

Premium Materials: We use 100% solid, sustainable New Zealand Pinewood, and some panels feature CARB II compliant MDF and 100% wood veneers.
Non-Toxic Finishes: Our products are finished with a non-toxic multi-step painting process that is lead and phthalate safe. We ensure formaldehyde and lead-safe paints with undetectable levels of formaldehyde and very low VOCs.
Rigorous Testing & Safety Standards: All our products meet or exceed ASTM International and U.S. CPSC safety standards. We send our products to a third-party CPSC-certified lab for testing, and 25% of our full-size crib models are tested quarterly. We also perform annual paint tests and have our own rigorous quality control program.
GREENGUARD Gold Certified: Many of our products, including our cribs, are GREENGUARD Gold certified. This means they have been independently tested and verified to meet rigorous safety standards for chemical emissions and volatile organic compounds (VOCs), ensuring healthier indoor air quality for your little one.
